description: pith: keep huge pastes out of context, point Claude at CI run summaries, and summarise giant command output

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/pith"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$P" hook prompt; else python "$P" hook prompt; fi
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/pith"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$P" hook post-bash; else python "$P" hook post-bash; fi
